---
title: "Explorer"
subtitle: "Alle evolutionären Kräfte kombinieren"
description: "Eigene Experimente mit Drift, Selektion, Mutation, Migration, Inzucht und Flaschenhals."
toc: false
---

{{< include /_partials/_setup.qmd >}}

Hier können Sie alle Prozesse gleichzeitig einschalten und eigene Experimente planen.
Wählen Sie eine **Voreinstellung** oder beginnen Sie mit dem Hardy-Weinberg-Fall und verändern Sie einen Parameter nach dem anderen.

```{ojs}
//| include: false
// Presets come from config/scenarios.json. A link like explorer.html?preset=drift-10 selects one.
scenarioFile = FileAttachment("/config/scenarios.json").json()
scenarios = scenarioFile.scenarios
urlPreset = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("preset")
initialScenario = scenarios.find(s => s.id === urlPreset) ?? scenarios[0]
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof scenario = Inputs.select(scenarios, {label: "Voreinstellung", format: s => s.label, value: initialScenario})
```

```{ojs}
//| include: false
// Defaults come straight from the R function simulate() (its formal arguments).
defaults = R.eval("lapply(formals(simulate), eval)")
S = ({...defaults, ...scenario.params})
```

```{ojs}
md`*${scenario.description ?? ""}*`
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Population

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof infinite = Inputs.toggle({label: "Unendlich grosse Population (keine Drift)", value: S.N === null || S.N === Infinity})
viewof N = Inputs.range([2, 100000], {value: Number.isFinite(S.N) ? S.N : 1000, step: 1, transform: Math.log, label: "Populationsgrösse N", disabled: infinite})
viewof p0 = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: S.p0, step: 0.01, label: "Start-Allelfrequenz p₀"})
viewof generations = Inputs.range([1, 1000], {value: S.generations, step: 1, label: "Generationen"})
viewof replicates = Inputs.range([1, 100], {value: S.replicates, step: 1, label: "Anzahl Populationen", disabled: infinite})
```

## Selektion

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof w11 = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: S.w11, step: 0.01, label: "Fitness w₁₁ (A1A1)"})
viewof w12 = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: S.w12, step: 0.01, label: "Fitness w₁₂ (A1A2)"})
viewof w22 = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: S.w22, step: 0.01, label: "Fitness w₂₂ (A2A2)"})
```

## Mutation

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof u = Inputs.number([0, 0.1], {value: S.u, step: 0.00001, label: "u (A1 → A2)"})
viewof v = Inputs.number([0, 0.1], {value: S.v, step: 0.00001, label: "v (A2 → A1)"})
```

## Migration

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof m = Inputs.range([0, 0.5], {value: S.m, step: 0.005, label: "Migrationsrate m"})
viewof pC = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: S.pC, step: 0.01, label: "Allelfrequenz der Quelle p_C"})
```

## Inzucht

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof F = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: S.F, step: 0.01, label: "Inzuchtkoeffizient F"})
```

## Flaschenhals

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof useBottleneck = Inputs.toggle({label: "Flaschenhals einschalten", value: S.bottleneck !== null})
viewof bStart = Inputs.range([1, 500], {value: S.bottleneck?.start ?? 20, step: 1, label: "Beginn (Generation)", disabled: !useBottleneck})
viewof bDuration = Inputs.range([1, 100], {value: S.bottleneck?.duration ?? 5, step: 1, label: "Dauer (Generationen)", disabled: !useBottleneck})
viewof bSize = Inputs.range([2, 1000], {value: S.bottleneck?.size ?? 25, step: 1, transform: Math.log, label: "Grösse im Flaschenhals", disabled: !useBottleneck})
```

:::

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof seed = Inputs.button("Neu simulieren", {value: 1, reduce: (x) => x + 1})
```

```{ojs}
//| include: false
params = ({
  p0, generations, w11, w12, w22, u, v, m, pC, F, seed,
  N: infinite ? Infinity : N,
  bottleneck: useBottleneck && !infinite ? {start: bStart, duration: bDuration, size: bSize} : null
})
nRep = infinite ? 1 : replicates
res = R.call("experiment", {...params, replicates: nRep}, {key: "explorer"})
rows = res.rows
summary = res.summary[0]
```

### Allelfrequenz

```{ojs}
alleleTrajectoryPlot(Plot, rows, {width})
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="stat-row">
  <div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-label">Mittelwert p (letzte Gen.)</div><div class="stat-value">${summary.mean.toFixed(3)}</div></div>
  <div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-label">Standardabweichung</div><div class="stat-value">${nRep > 1 ? summary.sd.toFixed(3) : "–"}</div></div>
  <div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-label">A1 fixiert</div><div class="stat-value">${summary.fixed} / ${summary.n}</div></div>
  <div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-label">A1 verloren</div><div class="stat-value">${summary.lost} / ${summary.n}</div></div>
</div>`
```

### Genotypfrequenzen (Population 1)

```{ojs}
genotypePlot(Plot, res.genotypes, {width})
```

```{ojs}
nRep > 1 ? html`<h3>Verteilung der Endfrequenzen</h3>${finalFrequencyHistogram(Plot, rows, {width})}` : html``
```

### Daten

```{ojs}
csv = d3.csvFormat(rows.map(({rep, gen, N, p, q, f11, f12, f22}) => ({population: rep, generation: gen, N, p, q, A1A1: f11, A1A2: f12, A2A2: f22})))
html`<p>${DOM.download(new Blob([csv], {type: "text/csv"}), "popgen-simulation.csv", "Daten als CSV herunterladen")}
<span style="opacity:.7"> · ${rows.length.toLocaleString("de-CH")} Zeilen, z. B. für die Auswertung in R</span></p>`
```

```{ojs}
shareUrl = `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}?preset=${scenario.id}`
md`Link zu dieser Voreinstellung: [${shareUrl}](${shareUrl})`
```
